## What's changed

- Improved grenade prediction with full grenade-volume collision, multi-contact handling and smoother trajectory updates.
- Smoothed Nade Helper aiming and made lineup trajectory checks match the in-game grenade hull more closely.
- Expanded the active bind list, including damage overrides, and added separate filters for Always, Hold and Toggle binds.
- Reworked Event Log so trigger shots, hits, kills and misses are correlated into useful single events with category filters.
- Moved No Flash world rendering to a depth-aware GPU pass for better coverage and performance.
- Added GPU No Smoke wireframe rendering for the visible geometry inside active smoke volumes.
